findings.title: Do not infer an untested token-ceiling counterfactual
findings.observed_text: Shortening a contract can therefore remove necessary placement information while leaving a misleading response-shaped example. More token room would not fix this particular failure.
findings.finding: The retained replies establish layout-description copying without observed truncation. They do not isolate shortening as the cause, establish that placement information was removed, or compare a larger completion ceiling. The claim that more room would not fix the failure exceeds the measured comparison.
findings.suggested_replacement: The replies copied the layout description despite its placement instructions. No reply hit its token ceiling, so truncation does not explain these failures; the effect of a higher ceiling is untested.
findings.disposition: Owner changed the guide; reviewer inspected the final paragraph and verified the final document hash.
findings.resolution: The final guide reports layout copying, observes that no ceiling was hit, and explicitly leaves the effect of a higher ceiling untested. The causal-shortening diagnosis was removed.
